reviews.text: This place is the worst. I went there in the early morning so they could treat my cat, who could not breathe, and they only did chest tests, came up with the wrong diagnosis, and took more than five hours to get the results. They made us spend a large amount of money for a wrong diagnosis. The next day, I went to my regular veterinarian, where they did tests on his head, chest, and absolutely everything, and they determined that it was not the diagnosis this clinic had given us and found the actual diagnosis. Now this clinic made us spend a large amount of money and gave us the wrong diagnosis, and we were giving our cat the wrong medication because their diagnosis was not the correct one.
I can trust everyone in this clinic to take care of my pet.

I have been a client of Dr. Crespo for more than 5 years and I will never see another vet as long as she is there. She is excellent when it comes to my German Shepherd who can sometimes be a bit moody but he loves her. As for the staff, they are all very welcoming and remembers me and my pets as if we go there everyday and I LOVE that. I can only say the best of the best when it comes to this place.
I take my dogs every time I go to Miami, they are super nice and helpful with everything. They also speak Spanish. Thanks from Cheeky and Daisy

I am extremely disappointed with the way Bayshore Veterinary Clinic organized my appointment.
I specifically scheduled Lady for 11:00 AM and was looking forward to it. On the day of the appointment, I received a reminder that the appointment was scheduled for 10:30 AM.
Rescheduling an appointment is unacceptable, especially when people are scheduling their entire schedule around a veterinary appointment.
Because of this experience, I will be going to a different veterinary clinic.
I expected much better organization, communication, and accountability from a veterinary clinic. The staff is rude!

This clinic is absolutely terrible. The service is unprofessional, disorganized, and unreliable.

They do not respond promptly to emails and fail to provide important medical and vaccination documents when urgently requested. I repeatedly asked for my dog’s electronic vaccination certificate and complete medical records, but the clinic did not handle the request with the urgency or professionalism expected from a veterinary practice.

Because of their poor communication and failure to provide proper documentation, I was forced to urgently search for another veterinary clinic.

Bayshore Veterinary Clinic does not provide its services responsibly or to an acceptable standard. I would not recommend this clinic to anyone who needs reliable veterinary care, clear communication, or timely access to their pet’s medical records.

The entire team at Bayshore Veterinary Clinic provided us with excellent care. Despite it being our first visit, they attended to us without delay. The doctor and nurse explained all the procedures my pet needed. Without a doubt, my favorite clinic and team. Thank you for all the kindness.

Thank you so much for the wonderful five-star review! We're thrilled to hear you had a great experience with us. It’s always our goal to provide the best possible care for both pets and their people, and your kind words mean the world to our team.
“We don’t give prices over the phone unless you’re already a client.” Quickest way to never get me to be a client. Price transparency is so easy, so this is just an incredibly shady move.

Dr. Crespo was very attentive and was able to diagnose my dog’s condition. Valentina the doctors assistant was very helpful , warm & friendly. I would recommend Bayshore Veterinary Clinic to my friends & relatives.
Thank you so much, Sheyla! We truly appreciate your review and are so glad you had a great experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again!
High standard of pet care! The team and Dr are very knowledgable, friendly and professional individuals. My Fiona was in the greatest care and for that I am most grateful! Thank you❤️❣️
Amazing Clinic. Can't recommend enough. Took good care of my dog, Chris, through all stages of his long life. Will never forget all the good that they do.

We feel very lucky to have found Bayshore. We have two Boston Terriers, one 1 year old and one 13 years old. Our puppy had been experiencing some vomiting issues for a few days, and they were able to see him the same day and rule out any serious concerns.

Dr. Crespo and Carol both have Boston Terriers, which made me feel especially comfortable knowing they are knowledgeable about the breed. I highly recommend them. They are kind, attentive, and always willing to help.

I also really appreciate how transparent they are with pricing. They review costs with you before payment and allow you to choose what is manageable that day. We love our Bostons and feel very confident in their care here.

We’re so lucky to have found Bayshore! The whole team is so professional, kind, and knowledgeable. We’ve taken our cats here since 2022 and I could never imagine bringing them anywhere else. We recently had to put our oldest cat to sleep and I could have never imagined the level of care she received and how supportive the whole team was. I cannot be appreciative enough to know our Lucy really received the best care in her final years and to feel like she was truly loved by everyone! We’ll always bring our other cats to them! Thank you Bayshore!
I am very pleased with the attention received. Very friendly, and caring staff. Thank you.
i’ve been taking my cat here since i adopted her, Dr. Crespo and Dr. Davila are amazing! all the staff are so kind and so helpful 🩷

Horrible care for our family dog. She had expensive yearly "check ups" here and the plaque on her teeth was so bad THEY TOOK PICS for their use. Then we put her down. My 90 yr old Mother was DEVASTATED.
This is the best hospital for our children!!!! Dr. Margarita! Thank you!!! I admire this hospital!!!! Thank you for being here!!! Hello from Milky❤️
The entire experience from the first call was efficient, professional and very welcoming   Dr Davila was wonderful with our pet, putting us all at ease.
Excellent service, very kind to my dog

They don't audit the medication or follow up properly. I received an empty pack of meds.

I called them immediately after over the weekend to request a refund since the timeline was over anyways. (Supposed to give her in 3 days only)

In the end, the front desk sent me a msg from their vet tech supervisor!
"Next time, count the medicine when you get it and call us asap."

Really? Aren't professionals supposed to handle medications correctly? I must sit there to count? Lol
Plus, How early am i supposed to call? Well, Open on Sunday too before complaining it to me.

I'm not going back to support this kind of group.

Thank you so much for your generous five-star review! We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us.
Your kind words motivate us to continue delivering compassionate, high-quality veterinary care.We're grateful to have you as part of our clinic family, and we look forward to seeing you again soon!

I called for a new patient appointment for my dog They sent me a form to fill out on line which I did when I got home from work. I received an email this morning that they canceled my appointment because they didn’t receive the form by 3pm? I advise you find an office that has humans run it, not a computer. They lost a new patient! When I called the office they didn’t care- no apology- no offer to reschedule. This is not a professional way to treat people!
The best vet ever. We have been their patient for atleast 20 years. All our dogs,  past and new are their babies as well. They treat our pets like they are their pets. Love them truly
Excellent care!
We're so grateful for your 5-star review! It means a lot to us that you took the time to share your experience.We truly appreciate your support.

Thank you so much for the five-star review! We're so glad to hear you had a positive experience at our hospital. Our team is dedicated to providing compassionate, high-quality care, and it’s always rewarding to know we’re making a difference. We truly appreciate your trust in us.

Absolutely fantastic service! The staff at this vet clinic are truly amazing—friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. They took great care of Jagger and made sure we felt comfortable and informed every step of the way. Highly recommended!
Great staff was very helpful they will take care of you.
Excellent service.
The best vet and the best place for our Bruno! They always treat him with so much love and care. Totally recommend!

Dr. Crespo is excellent. My dog always receives the best treatment here, and the staff clearly cares deeply for animals. Whenever my dog has faced a health problem, they have been thorough in their diagnosis and effective in finding solutions. I have complete trust Dr. Crespo's expertise and wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking for a wonderful vet.
Best service!

The BESTTTT Vet clinic I have ever been to, i’m so glad I came here. I came here as an emergency because my poor dog was having trouble breathing, and all the vets came SO quickly and helped my baby in a blink of an eye. I couldn’t be more thankful, I left the same day happy and experienced the best service, I promise you they would treat your dog/cat like their own! Thank you so much Dr crespo, and everyone in the clinic! Lula couldn’t be healthier and happier <3
I love Dr Davilla. She is amazing and has been so great with my three dogs. Especially one that is sick. I cannot recommend them enough. Love all the staff.
Thank you for your 5 star review! It's an honor to take care of your pets!

Simply an amazing experience and service. I brought my golden doodle in for a check up and a skin issue and felt very reassured and at peace after the diagnosis from the veterinarian. Special praise to Sandra for her care and attention, truly unforgettable.

Excellent care and fantastic staff. The staff at Bayshore are the most caring, gentle and considerate. You can trust that your beloved fur babies are being handled with the utmost sensitivity. I highly recommend them, very reliable A+ service.

Dr. Crespo and her team at Bayshore are truly exceptional veterinarians. I was initially hesitant to change vets because my dog struggles with anxiety around new people and environments. However, Bayshore provided outstanding service, demonstrating a wonderful bedside manner that helped ease my worries throughout the entire experience. I never felt like they were motivated by profit; instead, I felt that their recommendations were genuinely in the best interest of my dog, unlike many other veterinary practices I’ve encountered. I wholeheartedly recommend Bayshore!
Amazing staff, calm and caring. The Vets are amazing.

Dr. Davila and the team at Bayshore are so great. They've taken amazing care of our two dogs, throughout many injuries, illnesses, and surgical procedures. They are always available to answer my questions, and make our dogs feel comfortable when visiting. One of them even looks forward to it.haha I'd recommend them to anyone looking for pet care.

Loved the office and Dr. Crespo!
Very happy.

Dr. Crespo, Dr. Dávila and the entire veterinary staff at Bayshore provide excellent service and can handle even most difficult feline personalities. They are not only knowledgeable and thorough, but they are always treat my cat with the …
